Who We Are

Human Accuracy
Software Can't Match

True Trace Measurements delivers professional roof measurement reports to roofing contractors, public adjusters, and insurance companies across all 50 states.

Every report is hand-traced by our estimator directly from high-resolution Nearmap aerial imagery — not generated by automated software. Complex rooflines, heavy tree coverage, and rural properties are no problem.

✦Certified Xactimate estimators on every job
✦ESX and XML files with all measurements pre-loaded — ready for Xactimate or AppliCad
✦Complex, commercial, and blueprint jobs accepted
✦Free revision guarantee on every report
✦1 business day or less — all services

Deliverables
What's Inside
Every Report

Every report is checked before delivery. You receive a detailed PDF and an ESX file (Xactimate) or XML file (AppliCad / Symbility) with all measurements included.

📄 PDF Report — Detailed Visual Output
✔
Total Roof Area — total squares with full facet breakdown
✔
Pitch / Slope Breakdown — every facet labeled with exact pitch value
✔
Linear Measurements — ridge, rake, hip, valley, eave, flashing lengths
✔
3D Color-Coded Roof Diagram — visual facet map for quick reference
✔
Aerial Property Image — high-resolution satellite view with roof outlined
✔
Ice & Water Shield Areas — eave and valley areas pre-calculated
✔
Penetrations & Skylights — counted and noted where visible from aerial
💾 ESX / XML File — All Measurements Included
✔
Direct Xactimate Import — open instantly, all measurements and values pre-loaded
✔
All Facets Pre-drawn — every section mapped with correct dimensions
✔
Pitch Values Embedded — each facet carries its pitch for auto calculations
✔
Edge Types Classified — ridge, rake, hip, valley, eave labeled correctly
✔
3D Rendered Views — multiple angle 3D model of the complete roof
✔
AppliCad XML — opens in Symbility — on request at no additional charge
✔
Quality Checked — every report reviewed before delivery to ensure accuracy
How It Works
From Submission
to Delivery
1
Submit Your Job
Fill out our simple order form with the property address, report type, and any special notes. Attach blueprints if ordering a blueprint-based report.
Takes 2 minutes
2
We Confirm & Invoice
We confirm receipt within 1 hour and send a payment invoice. Work begins immediately upon payment confirmation via Credit/Debit Card or bank transfer.
Within 1 hour
3
Hand-Traced by Our Estimator
Our estimator manually traces and measures every roof facet using high-resolution aerial imagery. No automation, no shortcuts.
12–24 hours
4
Quality Control Review
Every report is reviewed for accuracy before delivery — pitch values, linear measurements, and file integrity (ESX and XML) are all verified against our 99% accuracy standard.
Before every delivery
5
PDF + ESX/XML Delivered
Both files delivered to your email within the guaranteed turnaround window. Open ESX in Xactimate or XML in AppliCad/Symbility — all measurements are complete and ready to estimate.
On time, guaranteed
Hand-Traced in Xactimate
Address → Nearmap → Xactimate/AppliCad → ESX or XML + PDF

The Difference
You'll Notice Immediately

Our ESX and XML files contain all roof measurements, pitches, lengths and area values pre-loaded — ready for your estimating software. No manual data entry needed.

Accuracy You Can Rely On
